HAELE 3D - Portrait Studio Pro is a 3D facial anatomy drawing reference tool designed for beginner to advanced artists. With a diverse range of editable characters, expressions, lighting setups and environments, it serves as a resource for learning how to draw faces and heads. Whether your style is realistic, stylized, cartoon, anime or anything in between this is easy to use app complements tutorials and aids practicing your portrait drawing skills from sketch to finish.
